text.description_html:
Omnia 8190/B300-US32D Square Stainless Glass Door Handles

Modern design 1-1/8" square stainless steel glass door pull set from Omnia. The soft brushed stainless steel finish requires very little maintenance, designed to enhance any setting where a modern look is desired. Pair of handles back to back mounted for glass doors.

Also available: Longer 23-5/8" Modern Square Glass Door Handles

Specifications for Omnia 8190/B300-US32D Square Glass Door Handles

  • Overall Length: 15-3/4"
  • Center to Center Mount Holes: 11-13/16"
  • Projection: 3-9/16"
  • Clearance: 2-7/16"
  • Handle Diameter: 1-1/8" Square
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: US32D - Brushed Stainless Steel

Packaged with 2 door pull handles and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 5/8" thick glass doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls) **Drill holes in glass 5/8" diameter.
